proposed_comments.title: Release the submission state when a concurrent invocation is rejected
proposed_comments.body:
### Release the submission state when a concurrent invocation is rejected

**Severity:** `high`

When `StartInvoke` returns because `_handleInvokeTask` is already active, the rejected `PerformCommandMessage` never receives `OnInvocationCompleted`. The submitting parameters page therefore remains suspended and cannot recover after the active invocation finishes.

Please invoke the completion callback on this rejection path before returning so the caller releases its submission gate and resumes its parameter inputs.

confidence.rationale: The fork fix was built and the fresh Copilot pass returned no new findings.

proposed_comments.title: Do not silently discard text edits during submission
proposed_comments.body:
### Do not silently discard text edits during submission

**Severity:** `medium`

Returning from `TextChanged` while submission is active lets the textbox display a new value without updating the extension model. If the command returns `KeepOpen`, the visible text and the stored parameter remain inconsistent.

Either disable the bound input for the submission interval, or retain the latest deferred text and apply it through the normal write path when the page resumes. Preserve the successful dismissal/reset path so stale values are not restored after launch.
